At any speciﬁc time, you only pay for the number of vector ingestion OCUs that are allocated to
a pipeline, regardless of whether there's data ﬂowing through the pipeline. OpenSearch vector
ingestion immediately accommodates your workloads by scaling pipeline capacity up or down
based on usage.
